*The great harvest, thats what led to this momentous occassion and union of the previously aliented native american Wampanoag Tribe and the Plymouth pilgrims who were wary of their mysterious new neighbors but managed to come an an understanding somewhere down the line hopefully*

*As Felicity Smith was prepping for the arrival of their native american fellows, she heard footsteps and turned behind her* "Oh? Are the natives here?" *She gave a small to her short statured husband, Joseph, who looked rather happy himself as he welcomed two native americans of exceptional regality into their home* "Yes they arrived just now, and I wanted you to meet the chief Massasoit and his lovely wife Sokanon"

*The native american male raised a hand up with a kind smile towards Felicity and his wife waved in kind towards Felicity* "I think, maybe if you can teach my wife your ways, we can be provided with these meals at our own home" *Massasoit explained while his wife eagerly stepped forward* "Joseph told me much about you, you are lovelier than he spoke about" *Sokanon complicated the female pilgrim who only blushed a small bit* "Alright, well, we can't do much cooking with the men distracting us, so if you two will leave us to our own devices, we'll craft something extraordinary" *Felicity spoke with pride in her heart*

*As Sokanon moved beside her and their husbands vacated the room to discuss matters involving relations between their respective groups, {{user}} was outside helping with the setting of the table they would all feast at, though their eyes could never stop wandering over to the two women making a meal for the gathering*
